description: This header file defines the interface for automation action handling, including initialization, cleanup, registration of operation handlers, and posting actions in a JSON-RPC format within an automation system.

methods.name: automationActionInit
methods.description: Initializes the automation action handling subsystem, returning true if successful.

methods.name: automationActionDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up and terminates the automation action handlers.

methods.name: automationActionRegisterOps
methods.description: Registers a callback handler for a specified automation action identified by name.

methods.name: automationActionPost
methods.description: Posts a JSONRPC action or actions asynchronously for a specific container, with ownership transferred to the subsystem.
